items.headline: Week 9 has the ACC in the spotlight and backup QBs taking over the Big Ten
items.description: It's fitting the ACC is finally in the spotlight after wild weeks in the SEC and Big 12.

items.headline: Fresno State hosts Oregon State in Pac-12 matchup
items.description: Oregon State (5-2) at Fresno State (4-3), Oct. 31 at 11 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: DiLeva kicks career-long 53-yard FG in closing seconds, San Diego St. beats Fresno St. 26-23
items.description: — Jayden Denegal and wide receiver Bert Emanuel Jr. each threw a touchdown pass, Cooper DiLeva kicked a career-long 53-yard field goal with 57 seconds left, and San Diego State beat Fresno State 26-23 on Saturday night.

items.headline: Ranking college football's best 60 receivers of the last 50 years
items.description: As Jeremiah Smith continues to amaze, Bill Connelly looks at where his career fits among the best ever.

items.headline: Fresno State visits San Diego State in Pac-12 action
items.description: Fresno State (4-2) at San Diego State (2-4), Oct. 17 at 10:30 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Dylan Riley leads No. 23 Boise State past Fresno State, 38-31
items.description: — Dylan Riley ran for 150 yards and a touchdown on 19 carries and scored on a 44-yard catch-and-run to help No. 23 Boise State beat Fresno State 38-31 on Saturday night to end a three-game skid against the Bulldogs.
